ns2:course.label: Undergraduate Research Experience
ns2:course.description: Laboratory and/or field research and/or reading supervised by faculty members in the School of Integrative Biology. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated in separate terms up to 10 hours, if topics vary. Credit is not given for more than a combined maximum of 10 hours of IB 390 or IB 490 towards graduation for IB majors. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
